I farm this maize plot much like I did last season, but I keep my spending tight because this land is rented and I am not going to put too much cash there. I will plant improved seed because I have seen it do better here in Iringa when the rains are good, and I will put a small amount of fertilizer, not a heavy rate. I will not carry manure to this plot and I will not irrigate, because I depend on the rains and the cost is too much. Most of the work I will do with my family, then I will hire a few days for land preparation and weeding when the work comes all at once.
